About

I'm a PGDM candidate in Marketing at the Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon (Class of 2027), and I want to build a career in advertising, brand management and public relations.

This summer I interned with Zeno Group's earned media and influencer marketing team in Gurgaon. I ran category communications for two international agricultural commodity boards, Australian Avocados and Turkish Hazelnuts, and an IPL-season influencer campaign for Tecno Mobile.

Before business school I was a journalist. I covered global tech and business for TechStory and put together full-page features for The Tribune's School Tribune section. My writing has also run in national food and lifestyle publications, both under my own byline and ghostwritten for others.

300+articles published
4months
6beats

I wrote 300+ news stories for TechStory between November 2021 and February 2022. Most days I filed several pieces across Big Tech, privacy, markets, policy, consumer tech and internet culture, often working from SEC filings, court rulings and regulator statements. Every piece was written for search as well as for readers, with keyword-led headlines, clear structure and copy built to rank and get read.

What this work built

  • Writing to deadline. Several publish-ready stories a day on fast-moving news.
  • Research and fact-checking. Working from primary sources like filings, court documents and official statements.
  • Plain-language explaining. Turning tech, legal and financial stories into copy a general reader can follow.
  • SEO copywriting. Keyword-led headlines, search-friendly structure and meta copy that help stories rank.
  • Headlines for online readers. Framing each story so it gets the click and stays accurate.
  • Range across beats. Switching between antitrust, data privacy, chips, markets and culture in the same week.
